title: UFO waves in Dalarna

tellings.quote:
We have in
Sweden Dalana which is in the middle of
Sweden where we have had several waves
of UFO observations.

plain: Dalarna, a region in the middle of Sweden, has had several waves of UFO sightings, according to Clas Svahn, a Swedish UFO researcher who keeps a large archive of reports. He mentions it to Michels as a known hotspot, without going into particular cases.
